KNIFEHERO-STEALTH.title: Stealth
KNIFEHERO-STEALTH.description: Incoming attacks are capped at 1 damage, plus your Heat. If you lose HP, you lose all Stealth and gain 1 Heat. Each hit also removes Heat Stealth.
KNIFEHERO-STEALTH.smartDescription: Incoming attacks are capped at 1 damage, plus your Heat. If you lose HP, you lose all Stealth and gain 1 Heat. Each hit also removes Heat Stealth.
KNIFEHERO-CLOSETED.title: Closeted
KNIFEHERO-CLOSETED.description: At the start of your turn, discard a card to prevent the next damage you would take. If you can't, lose Closeted and add a Dazed to your hand. Playing an Attack removes all your Stealth and Closeted.
KNIFEHERO-CLOSETED.smartDescription: At the start of your turn, discard a card to prevent the next damage you would take. If you can't, lose Closeted and add a Dazed to your hand. Playing an Attack removes all your Stealth and Closeted.
KNIFEHERO-DISCOURSED.title: Discoursed
KNIFEHERO-DISCOURSED.description: Gain less energy at the start of your next turn, then this wears off.
KNIFEHERO-DISCOURSED.smartDescription: Gain less energy at the start of your next turn, then this wears off.
KNIFEHERO-EXTREMELY_ONLINE_POWER.title: Extremely Online
KNIFEHERO-EXTREMELY_ONLINE_POWER.descrip: Gain energy at the start of each turn. This is a Flag.
KNIFEHERO-EXTREMELY_ONLINE_POWER.smartDe: Gain energy at the start of each turn. This is a Flag.

KNIFEHERO-EXPLOSIVE_TIP_POWER.title: Explosive Tip
KNIFEHERO-EXPLOSIVE_TIP_POWER.descriptio: This turn, the Shivs you play hit all enemies and Exhaust.
KNIFEHERO-EXPLOSIVE_TIP_POWER.smartDescr: This turn, your Shivs hit all enemies and Exhaust.
KNIFEHERO-LESSON.title: Lesson
KNIFEHERO-LESSON.description: What you have learned. Needed (with Grief) to process your parts, and spent by some cards.
KNIFEHERO-LESSON.smartDescription: What you have learned. Needed to process your parts, and spent by some cards.
KNIFEHERO-MARGINALIA_POWER.title: Marginalia
KNIFEHERO-MARGINALIA_POWER.description: Whenever you play a Book or a Power, gain 1 Lesson.
KNIFEHERO-MARGINALIA_POWER.smartDescript: Whenever you play a Book or a Power, gain 1 Lesson.
KNIFEHERO-POLYMATH_POWER.title: Polymath
KNIFEHERO-POLYMATH_POWER.description: At the start of each turn, gain Lessons.
KNIFEHERO-POLYMATH_POWER.smartDescriptio: At the start of each turn, gain Lessons.
KNIFEHERO-GRIEF.title: Grief
KNIFEHERO-GRIEF.description: Accumulated grief — a part of you that aches. Some cards make you lose HP equal to your Grief; others (Wallow) turn it into Block. Process a Throbbing Heart to reset it.
KNIFEHERO-GRIEF.smartDescription: Grief: some cards lose you HP equal to it; some turn it into Block.
KNIFEHERO-WHOLENESS.title: Wholeness
KNIFEHERO-WHOLENESS.description: You have mended this many parts. Each grants +2 max HP. At the start of your turn, heal HP equal to your Wholeness.
KNIFEHERO-WHOLENESS.smartDescription: At the start of your turn, heal Wholeness HP.
KNIFEHERO-BECOME_WHO_YOU_ARE_POWER.title: Become Who You Are
KNIFEHERO-BECOME_WHO_YOU_ARE_POWER.descr: At the start of each turn, gain Strength equal to your number of Powers, then gain 1 Lesson.
KNIFEHERO-BECOME_WHO_YOU_ARE_POWER.smart: At the start of each turn, gain Strength equal to your Powers, then gain 1 Lesson.
KNIFEHERO-PRIDES_PLAYED.title: Prides Played
KNIFEHERO-PRIDES_PLAYED.description: The number of Pride cards you have played this combat.
KNIFEHERO-PRIDES_PLAYED.smartDescription: The number of Pride cards you have played this combat.
KNIFEHERO-HEAT.title: Heat
KNIFEHERO-HEAT.description: They know roughly where you are. Attacks against you deal 1 more damage, and each hit removes 1 more Stealth.
KNIFEHERO-HEAT.smartDescription: They know roughly where you are. Attacks against you deal 1 more damage, and each hit removes 1 more Stealth.
KNIFEHERO-UNSEEN.title: Unseen
KNIFEHERO-UNSEEN.description: Your attacks do not break your Stealth this turn.
KNIFEHERO-UNSEEN.smartDescription: Your attacks do not break your Stealth this turn.
KNIFEHERO-PICKPOCKET_POWER.title: Pickpocket
KNIFEHERO-PICKPOCKET_POWER.description: The first time you deal damage each turn, gain a Shiv.
KNIFEHERO-PICKPOCKET_POWER.smartDescript: The first time you deal damage each turn, gain a Shiv.
KNIFEHERO-DEAD_NAME_POWER.title: Dead Name
KNIFEHERO-DEAD_NAME_POWER.description: Whenever you would gain Heat, add a Dazed to your discard pile instead.
KNIFEHERO-DEAD_NAME_POWER.smartDescripti: Whenever you would gain Heat, add a Dazed to your discard pile instead.
KNIFEHERO-REGENT_PRIDE_POWER.title: Regent Pride
KNIFEHERO-REGENT_PRIDE_POWER.description: At the start of each turn, deal 6 damage to an enemy and gain 6 Block.
KNIFEHERO-REGENT_PRIDE_POWER.smartDescri: At the start of each turn, deal 6 damage to an enemy and gain 6 Block.
KNIFEHERO-DOUBLE_SHOT.title: Double Shot
KNIFEHERO-DOUBLE_SHOT.description: The next Attack you play is played twice.
KNIFEHERO-DOUBLE_SHOT.smartDescription: The next Attack you play is played twice.
KNIFEHERO-BOTH_IS_GOOD_POWER.title: Both Is Good
KNIFEHERO-BOTH_IS_GOOD_POWER.description: The first Pride card you play each turn also triggers its end-of-turn effect.
KNIFEHERO-BOTH_IS_GOOD_POWER.smartDescri: The first Pride card you play each turn also triggers its end-of-turn effect.
